Software Engineer I — Payments Platform
Northwind Financial Group

ABOUT NORTHWIND
Founded in 1998, Northwind Financial Group is a leading provider of payment
infrastructure serving over 4,000 merchants across 12 countries. Our mission is
to make commerce accessible to everyone, everywhere. We have been named one of
the Best Places to Work for six consecutive years and are proud of our
collaborative, fast-paced, results-oriented culture.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Develop and maintain microservices in Java using Spring Boot
- Integrate with third-party payment providers over REST and webhooks
- Write automated tests and participate in continuous deployment
- Collaborate with product managers and designers in an Agile environment

WHAT YOU NEED
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent experience
- 0-2 years of professional software development experience
- Proficiency in Java; familiarity with Spring Boot is required
- Solid understanding of relational databases and SQL
- Experience with Git

NICE TO HAVE
- Exposure to Kafka or other message queues
- Knowledge of payment systems, PCI DSS or financial regulations
- Experience with AWS

BENEFITS
Competitive salary. Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage effective
day one. 401(k) with 5% company match. Unlimited paid time off. Annual learning
stipend of $2,000. Hybrid working with three days in office. Free lunch on
Wednesdays. Wellness reimbursement. Parental leave of 16 weeks.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
Northwind Financial Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified
applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race,
colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin,
disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by
law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with
disabilities. If you require accommodation, please contact our recruiting team.

HOW TO APPLY
Submit your resume through our careers portal. Applications sent by email will
not be considered. Due to the volume of applications we are unable to respond
to every applicant individually.
